item.title: The Danny Moses Show: What exactly is a K-shaped economy?
item.description: Danny Moses breaks down the growing divide between high-income and lower-income consumers, the wealth effect driving spending, and the risks of the high-income market segment weakening.

item.title: TSA says PreCheck still operational after previous announcement of suspension during funding fight
item.description: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs as a partial government shutdown continues.

item.title: Buy now, pay later warning: Rising number of users missing payments
item.description: BNPL plans let you spread out payments over time, without running up credit card debt. But a new survey finds a growing number of users falling behind, and racking up new levels of debt.

item.title: US citizens in Mexico urged to shelter in place after killing of cartel leader
item.description: U.S. citizens in several cities across Mexico have been urged to shelter in place amid widespread violence following the killing of the leader of a powerful cartel.

item.title: 'Surreal sight to see': US tourist describes chaotic scenes in Mexico amid cartel violence
item.description: A Scripps News Group employee vacationing in Puerto Vallarta described surreal scenes of burning cars and heavy smoke as cartel violence grips Mexico after the killing of a drug kingpin.

item.title: Is Mexico still safe? Nervous travelers look for alternate destinations
item.description: After this past weekend's violence in Puerto Vallarta, many travelers are rethinking their vacation plans to Mexico. A Mexican travel specialist tells us about alternatives.

item.title: Phil Collins, Lauryn Hill, INXS, Iron Maiden, Luther Vandross and Shakira get Rock Hall nominations
item.description: Phil Collins, Mariah Carey, Lauryn Hill, INXS, Iron Maiden, Luther Vandross and Shakira are some the 2026 nominees for induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame.

item.title: Movie tickets cost how much? Here's how to stop overpaying
item.description: Movie ticket prices are up 60% since 2016. Here's how to save on tickets and snacks at AMC and Cinemark.

item.title: What the Tooth Fairy left behind could spark your next family debate
item.description: The Tooth Fairy’s average payout is up 17% from last year, and more kids are getting non-cash surprises under their pillows, according to a new survey.

item.title: Walmart cottage cheese recalled in 24 states over pasteurization concerns
item.description: Three types of Walmart's Great Value brand cottage cheese are being recalled in 24 states over concerns the products may not have been properly pasteurized.
